input.task: Diagnose a material application defect without spending context on unrelated repository surfaces.

expected_behaviors: Orient on the observed failure and reproduce or explicitly preserve uncertainty
Use local evidence before conditional, version-aware upstream research
Apply the smallest evidence-backed fix and verify it before claiming resolution
Promote only reusable learning and escalate repeated failure classes
forbidden_behaviors: Search external community sources by default
Invent a root cause when reproduction or evidence is missing
Apply an old workaround without checking version compatibility
Declare a fix complete without observed verification
objective_checks: The fixture contains all seven required debugging scenarios
Each scenario defines input, expected behaviors, forbidden behaviors, and objective checks

scenarios.input: A local unit test fails with an observable assertion and no framework-specific evidence.
expected_behaviors: Investigate locally and reproduce the failing test before any web research.
objective_checks: Evidence records the failing test and the smallest affected code surface.

expected_behaviors: Confirm the installed Next.js version and consult current official upstream guidance before a workaround.
forbidden_behaviors: Assume advice for another Next.js version applies.
objective_checks: Research evidence identifies a compatible version and source.

scenarios.input: Old Reddit advice conflicts with the current framework documentation.
expected_behaviors: Treat the community advice as a hypothesis and follow compatible upstream evidence.
objective_checks: The chosen action states why version-compatible upstream guidance wins.

scenarios.input: A previously working user journey regresses and can be reproduced.
expected_behaviors: Add the smallest reliable regression coverage after the fix.
forbidden_behaviors: Rely only on a manual claim when an appropriate automated check is practical.
objective_checks: Coverage matches the failure surface: unit, integration, browser, eval, or static mechanism.

scenarios.input: The symptom is observed but cannot be reproduced and evidence does not isolate a cause.
expected_behaviors: State hypotheses and limitations without calling any hypothesis a verified root cause.
objective_checks: The result distinguishes symptom, hypothesis, and verified root cause.

scenarios.input: The same material failure class occurs for a second time after an earlier patch.
expected_behaviors: Investigate why earlier prevention failed and strengthen it proportionately.
forbidden_behaviors: Repeat only the earlier patch without reviewing prevention.
objective_checks: The response considers stronger coverage, validation, routing, or architecture protection.

scenarios.input: A code change is proposed as a fix but no relevant verification has been executed.
expected_behaviors: Keep the outcome unverified and run or state the required verification.
objective_checks: The final claim includes observed check result and limitations.
